title: AAI Recruitment 2026 – Consultant (SSCO) Posts
shortInfo: AAI has announced notification for Consultant (SSCO) posts. Required qualification: Graduate in any discipline, Basic ATC Course, ATM and AL (Basic), GCA/ATSS Course. Last date to apply: 01-10-26.

dates.event: Opening Date for Submission of Applications by Email
Last Date for Submission of Application

howToApply: Download the prescribed application form (Annexure-1) from the advertisement.
Fill in the application form completely with all required details.
Attach self-attested copies of all necessary supporting documents, Educational Qualifications and Work Experience.
Combine the duly filled application and all self-attested supporting documents into a single PDF file (size not exceeding 5 MB).
Send the PDF file to the email ID: chqrectt@aai.aero on or before the closing date, i.e., 01.10.2026.
Application through any other mode will NOT be accepted.
Ensure that the email ID provided in the application is maintained active for further communication.

title: Southern Railway Recruitment 2026 – Act Apprentices Posts
shortInfo: Southern Railway has announced notification for Act Apprentices posts. Required qualification: 10th, 12th, ITI. Last date to apply: 27-09-26.
howToApply: Visit the official website: www.sr.indianrailways.gov.in
Navigate to News & Updates → Personnel Branch Information
Click on the relevant notification link for Act Apprentices Notification No. 01/2026
Fill in the online application form with all required personal, educational and technical details
Upload required documents as specified
Pay the processing fee of Rs. 100/- through online mode (SC/ST/PwBD/Women candidates are exempted)
Submit the application before 27-09-2026 till 17:00 Hrs
Take a printout of the acknowledgement generated by the system for submission at the time of Document Verification

title: AAI Recruitment 2026 – Graduate Apprentice, Diploma Apprentice, ITI Apprentice Posts
shortInfo: AAI has announced notification for Graduate Apprentice, Diploma Apprentice, ITI Apprentice posts. Required qualification: Graduate Degree / Diploma / ITI. Last date to apply: Update.
howToApply: Graduate/Diploma candidates must register on the NATS portal: https://nats.education.gov.in
ITI candidates must register on the NAPS portal: https://www.apprenticeshipindia.gov.in
After registration, search for the concerned AAI Establishment ID corresponding to your preferred location.
Submit the online application through the respective portal.
Applications submitted through any other mode shall not be accepted.
